CLICK-THROUGH PROTOTYPE

Working controls — tap the bottom nav to move between Home, Squad, Market and League. The raised centre button opens the live match.

Under Squad, the Players/Tactics segment switches views; position chips filter the list; formation, mentality and speed controls all hold state.

Use the Club tweak above this artboard to switch club — every accent in the UI follows it.

All colour values are real: primaryColor out of src/data/plTeams.js, resolved through src/lib/theme.mjs, with contrast ratios from the same code that gates CI in tools/check-club-accents.mjs. Arsenal's squad — names, ratings, ages, potentials, values — is read out of the same data, with rating computed the way matchEngine's primaryRating() does.

Match state (GW 12, the 2-1 scoreline, budget, league points) is sample data chosen to show a mid-season screen.

STILL OPEN

pitch renders potential as star ratings (getPotentialStars). These screens use a POT number plus a growth arrow instead — faster to scan, and it doesn't compress five elite prospects into the same five stars.

Worth deciding explicitly before Phase 4 builds the Squad screen.
